title: fix(knowledge-turso): never drop a table the store did not make, and check knowledge_generation's shape at ready()
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP
Fixes #37956

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：云上租户的业务表和知识库放在同一个库时，知识库重建或删除知识源不会再删掉一张不是它自己建的表，而是拒绝并写明是哪张表；如果业务里有一张和知识库「代数登记表」同名的表，知识库会直接报「不可用」并点名这张表，不再悄悄失灵。知识库独占一个库时一切照旧。
- 为什么做：属于「知识检索平台化」专题——云上用 Turso 做知识库，必须保证它不会误删或误用客户的业务表。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是遇到同名的业务表时，该知识源的重建或删除被拒绝、要运维改名或移走那张表；客户数据不会被删，改动可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- **The three DROPs by generation-row name are shape-checked** (`turso-adapter.ts`): `beginBuild` replacing an unfinished build of another fingerprint, `completeBuild` dropping the replaced active generation, and `dropSource` for the active and building generations all go through one new helper, `dropGenerationTable`. It reads the table's columns with the same `shapeOf` / `tableShape` reading `openGeneration` already uses and drops only one of the store's own passage tables (or nothing, when no table is there). Any other table under that name is refused, never dropped: `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / 503, the message naming the table and the generation, the remedy saying to rename or remove it or keep the store in a database of its own. The refusal is thrown inside the call's write transaction, so nothing of the call lands (in `dropSource`, an active table dropped before the refused building one is rolled back too; pinned).
- **`ready()` checks `knowledge_generation`'s shape** before its `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`, which passes over any table of that name. `tableShape` (`sql.ts`) gains a `generation` reading: exactly the generation table's eight column names (`generationDdl`, unchanged since the package landed; checked at `40570d6fb4` and `d58bf7ab99`). Any other shape makes the store not ready: `healthCheck` answers `ok: false` and every call `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, the message naming `knowledge_generation`; the table is left as it is. Before, a foreign table with `source_id` and `state` columns took the store's two unique indexes and the store reported ready.
- `openGeneration`'s existing check is now spelled as the same allowlist (`none` or `passage`), so the new `generation` reading can never fall through it. Behaviour unchanged.
- No table prefix (card: it trips cloud's v18 verdict tool). `:670` and `:697` (the legacy DROPs, guarded by `hasLegacy`) are untouched.
- Docs: the package README (`dropSource`, the shared-database sentence under Rebuilds, "When it cannot run") and `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx` §4.2 (Rebuilds, When it cannot run) now say what is refused. The contract text in `packages/spec/src/contracts/knowledge-adapter.ts` has no sentence the refusal changes (it allows a coded refusal and does not promise `dropSource` never fails), so `packages/spec` is untouched.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/knowledge-turso` patch.

**Declarations, measured.** `Clause-②: no`, no arm: no published contract moves (no spec, export, error code or door shape; `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` is the code `openGeneration` already answers for the same condition), and nothing the documented contract accepts is refused after: the README and §4.2 already said a table of another shape under a store's name is "never dropped"; the three DROPs were the code breaking that sentence. `Metadata-protocol: none`: nothing a metadata author writes changes. Both match the claim.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in `src/__tests__/acceptance.test.ts`, "knowledge-turso beside object tables", run on `:memory:` and on a `file:` URL. Each drop case removes the store's own table where a generation row points and creates an object table (`id`, `name`, one row) under that name:

- `beginBuild` replacing an unfinished FP_B build whose table is an object table: refused `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / 503, message names `knowledge_ob_begin_g2`; the object row is still there, the generation rows are unchanged (`1:active`, `2:building`), the active generation still answers a search.
- `completeBuild` replacing an active generation whose table is an object table: refused, names `knowledge_ob_complete_g1`; object row kept; rows unchanged; `indexStatus` still reports FP_A and `building: true`.
- `dropSource` with the building generation's name taken: refused, names `knowledge_ob_drop_g2`; object row kept; rows unchanged; the active table (dropped first in the loop) is back after the rollback and still answers a search.
- Control, the normal paths: a third-fingerprint `beginBuild` drops the store's own unfinished build and remakes generation 2 empty; `completeBuild` drops the old active table; `dropSource` removes every table and row.
- `ready()`: an object table `knowledge_generation (id, source_id, state)` with a row: `healthCheck` `ok: false` naming the table; `upsert` refused 503 naming it; no index added to it; its row unchanged; no passage table made.
- Control: a second adapter on a database whose `knowledge_generation` is the store's own is ready and searches.

<details><summary>Readings (head e052afa1be)</summary>

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1` in `packages/plugins/knowledge-turso` (all four files), at `e052afa1be`: Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 185 passed (185). The acceptance file alone at `d240b499fa`: 54 passed (54). See Verification for how this run resolved workspace packages.
- Ablations, one per pin, each through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 to 0, blob changed, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty), the acceptance file filtered to the pin, red on both store kinds (2 failed, 52 skipped):
  1. `beginBuild` site put back to the raw `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS`: "expected a refusal, got an answer".
  2. `completeBuild` site, same: "expected a refusal, got an answer".
  3. `dropSource` site, same: "expected a refusal, got an answer".
  4. `ready()` check disabled (`if (false as boolean)`): `expected { ok: true, … } to match object { ok: false, … }`.
  5. `tableShape`'s `generation` line deleted: the second-adapter control goes red, `expected { ok: false, … } to deeply equal { ok: true, … }` (the store's own generation table would read as foreign).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Reads and writes into a generation's table (`upsert`'s DELETE / INSERT, `delete`, `listDocuments`, `search`) still go by the generation row's name without a shape read; only the DROPs were in scope. A foreign table there gets there only by the store's own table being removed by hand and an object table created under its name; cloud reserves these names at publish (cloud#4993, not this card). Not filed: no public-door repro.
- A store upgraded from the cloud-repo releases with a source named `generation` holds a legacy-shaped `knowledge_generation`. It was unavailable before too (its index DDL fails on the missing `source_id`); it is now unavailable with a reason naming the table.
- The generation table's indexes `knowledge_generation_active` / `_building` use `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS`; a foreign index already holding one of those names would be passed over. Not reachable from an object table (an object owns tables, not index names); noted, not filed.

## Verification

- Two minutes: in `packages/plugins/knowledge-turso`, run `pnpm exec vitest run src/__tests__/acceptance.test.ts -t "beside object tables"`; expect 12 passed (6 cases on two store kinds).
- Read first: `turso-adapter.ts` `dropGenerationTable` and its three call sites (the refusal must fire before any DROP and inside the transaction); `ready()`'s shape read before `generationDdl`; `sql.ts` `GENERATION_COLUMNS`.
- No container run: libSQL runs in the test process on `:memory:` and on a `file:` URL, the same engine and the same SQL (`pragma_table_info`, `DROP TABLE`, transactional DDL) a `libsql://` store runs; a booted app would reach these paths only through the same adapter calls the tests make, with a hand-made object table.
- How the local runs were made (declared narrowing): the shared verify lock was not acquired in five attempts over about 45 minutes (each a 9-minute queue-timeout, exit 99), so the dependency closure was not built. The vitest runs above went outside the lock, one worker, with a temporary config (not committed) that resolves every `@objectstack/*` workspace import to its `src/` instead of `dist/` (this package's own config already does so for `core`, `spec`, `service-knowledge` and `service-settings`). CI's `Test Core` runs the real config.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/knowledge-turso typecheck`: NOT MEASURED locally (needs `packages/spec/dist`, a lock-held build); CI's `TypeScript Type Check` carries it.
- Gate families (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 97 derived): 86 exit 0. 9 exit PREREQUISITE NOT MET for the same missing builds, NOT MEASURED locally (`check:docs` exit 1 "packages/spec/json-schema is missing"; exit 3: lint `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, spec `check:skill-examples`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`). 2 stopped by a 300 s local bound, NOT MEASURED (`check:query-options-erasure`, `check:type-check-debt`). `check:nul-bytes` exit 0. CI runs all of them.
- `overlap-check` before each push: VERDICT clean exit 0 (against `origin/main` and the open PRs sharing `knowledge.mdx`).
